title: MP3 Player!
description: Ever wanted a portable jukebox? that works with Custom Jukebox? Wow, so great!
body:
# MP3 Player Plugin 🎵💿

# THIS PLUGIN IS STILL VERY BUGGY BUT SOON FIXED!

Adds an MP3 player with a clickable UI! Right-click the player to open the interface where you can insert your music discs 💿. Discs are saved, and you can play ▶️ or stop ⏹️ them with a simple right-click.

Fully compatible with [BS CustomJukebox](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bs-customjukebox), automatically reading your custom discs.  

**Notes:**
- The MP3 player has no custom texture.
- Can be registered under **`minecraft:mp3player` as an custom item model**, as the plugin sets the item model automatically.
